definitions.gloss: personnel department; human resources department; HR department
definitions.explanation: The department within a company or organization responsible for hiring, employee management, training, evaluations, and labor relations.

examples.japanese: {人事部|じんじぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was assigned to the HR department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人事部|じんじぶ}にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please consult the HR department about transfers.

examples.japanese: {人事部|じんじぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新卒|しんそつ}{採用|さいよう}→新卒採用：29208_shinsotsusaiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The HR department announced the interview schedule for new graduate recruitment.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧ (personnel affairs) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (department). The standard term for the human resources department in Japanese companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人事部|じんじぶ}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧ (head of the HR department)
- {人事部|じんじぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧ (to consult with HR)
- {人事部|じんじぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧ (HR department staff member)
- {人事部|じんじぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{所属|しょぞく}→所属：12750_shozoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to belong to the HR department)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{総務部|そうむぶ}→総務部：23789_soumubu⟧ — general affairs department; handles administrative matters, sometimes overlaps with HR in smaller companies
- ⟦{人事課|じんじか}→人事課：19073_jinjika⟧ — personnel section; a smaller unit (section vs. department)
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦{開発部|かいはつぶ}→開発部：27444_kaihatsubu⟧ — human resources development department; focused on training and development

USAGE:
In Japanese corporate structure, {人事部|じんじぶ} is a powerful department that handles not only hiring but also the regular personnel rotations (⟦{人事異動|じんじいどう}→人事異動：18627_jinjiidou⟧) that are a distinctive feature of Japanese companies. Employees are periodically transferred between departments and locations, and {人事部|じんじぶ} manages this process.
